_meta.track_source: Hand-seeded coarse waypoints (approximate) pending the IBTrACS bake — pipeline/bake_tracks.py overwrites this with real best-track points in CI. SID references IBTrACS v04r01 (NOAA NCEI, public domain).
caveats: Track is a real historical storm shown as an analog — NOT a forecast for this location or date.
These are coarse hand-seeded waypoints, not full best-track resolution, until pipeline/bake_tracks.py runs in CI.
